# Set up environment and prepare data 
```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(gridExtra)
library(xlsx)

# Load metadata
metadata <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/phenotypes_filtered.txt", header=T)|>
  rename(Sample =samples ) |> 
  mutate(Age_cat = ifelse(binary==0, "EOD", "LOD/VLOD"))|> 
  filter(Sample != "ERR1672847")

# Load gene presence/absence  data
gene_pres_abs <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pangenome_analysis/gene_presence_absence.csv")

# List samples from each dataset
NL_metadata <- read.xlsx("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/0.Raw_data/Netherlands_Sanger_metadata.xlsx", 1) 
NL_samples <- NL_metadata |> filter(ENA.lane.accession %in% colnames(gene_pres_abs)) |> pull(ENA.lane.accession)
CDC_metadata <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Typing/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/phenotypes.txt", header=T) 
CDC_metadata <- CDC_metadata |> filter(samples %in% colnames(gene_pres_abs)) |> pull(samples)
TW_samples <- metadata |> filter(! Sample %in% c(NL_samples, CDC_metadata)) |> pull(Sample)
```

# 1. Plot gene frequencies Across Countries 
## 1.1. NL vs USA
```{r}
# Reformat gene presence/absence data
gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL <- gene_pres_abs |>  
  dplyr::select(contains(c("Gene", NL_samples, CDC_metadata))) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(c(NL_samples, CDC_metadata)), ~ ifelse(. == "", 0, 1)))

# Calculate the Total and proportion of samples carrying a given gene in each population
gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_V2 <- gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL |> 
  mutate(Total_NL = rowSums(across(all_of(NL_samples))), 
         Total_CDC = rowSums(across(all_of(CDC_metadata))), 
         Proportion_NL = Total_NL/length(NL_samples), 
         Proportion_CDC = Total_CDC/length(CDC_metadata)) |> 
  filter(Total_NL +Total_CDC !=0)

# All genes
# Create a data frame for shading the region (independent of gene_pres_abs_clean_V2)
shade_data <- data.frame(x = seq(0, 1, by = 0.01))
shade_data <- shade_data %>%
  mutate(ymin_5 = pmax(0, x - 0.05),
         ymax_5 = pmin(1, x + 0.05),
         ymin_10 = pmax(0, x - 0.10),
         ymax_10 = pmin(1, x + 0.10),
         ymin_15 = pmax(0, x - 0.15),
         ymax_15 = pmin(1, x + 0.15),
         ymin_25 = pmax(0, x - 0.25),
         ymax_25 = pmin(1, x + 0.25))

# Prepare data
gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_V3 <- gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_V2 |> 
  filter(!(Proportion_NL < 0.05 & Proportion_CDC < 0.05)) |> 
  mutate(Type = ifelse(Proportion_NL >= 0.95, 
                       ifelse(Proportion_CDC >= 0.95, "Core both", "Core NL"), 
                       ifelse(Proportion_CDC >= 0.95, "Core CDC", 
                              ifelse((Proportion_NL >= 0.05 & Proportion_CDC >= 0.05), "Accessory both", 
                                     ifelse((Proportion_NL >= 0.05 & Proportion_CDC < 0.05), "Accessory NL", "Accessory CDC")))))

# Correlation test 
## All genes
cor_test_USA_NL <- cor.test(gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_V3$Proportion_NL, gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_V3$Proportion_CDC)
cor_coefficient_USA_NL <- round(cor_test_USA_NL$estimate, 2)
p_value_USA_NL <- signif(cor_test_USA_NL$p.value, 3)
# Accessory in both genes
gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_V4 <- gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_V3 |>  filter(Type == "Accessory both")
cor_test_Accessory_USA_NL <- cor.test(gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_V4$Proportion_NL, gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_V4$Proportion_CDC)
cor_coefficient_Accessory_USA_NL  <- round(cor_test_Accessory_USA_NL$estimate, 2)
p_value_Accessory_USA_NL  <- signif(cor_test_Accessory_USA_NL$p.value, 3)


# plot 
p_USA_NL <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = shade_data, aes(x = x, ymin = ymin_5, ymax = ymax_5), fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_ribbon(data = shade_data, aes(x = x, ymin = ymin_25, ymax = ymax_25), fill = "grey95", alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_point(data= gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_V3, aes(x = Proportion_NL, y = Proportion_CDC, color = Type)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.05, 0.95), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.05, 0.95), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "black") +  
  theme_classic() +
  xlab(paste0("Gene frequencies in Netherlands (n=", length(NL_samples), ")")) +
  ylab(paste0("Gene frequencies in USA (n=", length(CDC_samples), ")")) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 0.9, hjust = 0, label = paste("Pearson's correlation:\nAll: r =", cor_coefficient_USA_NL, ", p ", ifelse(p_value_USA_NL==0, "< 0.001", paste("=",p_value_USA_NL)), "\nAccessory both: r =", cor_coefficient_Accessory_USA_NL, ", p ", ifelse(p_value_Accessory_USA_NL==0, "< 0.001", paste("=",p_value_Accessory_USA_NL))), size = 4, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#364B9A", "#4A7BB7","#98CAE1", "#A50026", "#F67E4B", "#FEDA8B"))+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Infant Invasive Disease (n=", (length(NL_samples)+length(CDC_samples)), ")"))

p_USA_NL

# save
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pangenome_analysis/1.COG_freq_correlation_USA_NL.png", plot = p_USA_NL, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")
```
## 1.2. TW vs USA
```{r}
# Reformat gene presence/absence data
gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_TW <- gene_pres_abs |>  
  dplyr::select(contains(c("Gene", TW_samples, CDC_metadata))) |>

  mutate(Total_TW = rowSums(across(all_of(TW_samples))), 
         Total_CDC = rowSums(across(all_of(CDC_metadata))), 
         Proportion_TW = Total_TW/length(TW_samples),

  filter(Total_TW +Total_CDC !=0)

shade_data <- shade_data %>%
  mutate(ymin_5 = pmax(0, x - 0.05),
         ymax_5 = pmin(1, x + 0.05),
         ymin_10 = pmax(0, x - 0.10),
         ymax_10 = pmin(1, x + 0.10),
         ymin_15 = pmax(0, x - 0.15),
         ymax_15 = pmin(1, x + 0.15),
         ymin_25 = pmax(0, x - 0.25),
         ymax_25 = pmin(1, x + 0.25))

# Prepare data

  filter(!(Proportion_TW < 0.05 & Proportion_CDC < 0.05)) |> 
  mutate(Type = ifelse(Proportion_TW >= 0.95, 
                       ifelse(Proportion_CDC >= 0.95, "Core both", "Core TW"), 
                       ifelse(Proportion_CDC >= 0.95, "Core CDC", 
                              ifelse((Proportion_TW >= 0.05 & Proportion_CDC >= 0.05), "Accessory both", 
                                     ifelse((Proportion_TW >= 0.05 & Proportion_CDC < 0.05), "Accessory TW", "Accessory CDC")))))

# Correlation test

cor_test_Accessory_USA_TW <- cor.test(gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_TW_V4$Proportion_TW, gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_TW_V4$Proportion_CDC)
cor_coefficient_Accessory_USA_TW  <- round(cor_test_Accessory_USA_TW$estimate, 2)
p_value_Accessory_USA_TW  <- signif(cor_test_Accessory_USA_TW$p.value, 3)


# plot

  geom_ribbon(data = shade_data, aes(x = x, ymin = ymin_5, ymax = ymax_5), fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_ribbon(data = shade_data, aes(x = x, ymin = ymin_25, ymax = ymax_25), fill = "grey95", alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_point(data= gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_TW_V3, aes(x = Proportion_TW, y = Proportion_CDC, color = Type)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.05, 0.95), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.05, 0.95), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "black") +  
  theme_classic() +
  xlab(paste0("Gene frequencies in Taiwan (n=", length(TW_samples), ")")) +
  ylab(paste0("Gene frequencies in USA (n=", length(CDC_metadata), ")")) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 0.9, hjust = 0, label = paste("Pearson's correlation:\nAll: r =", cor_coefficient_USA_TW, ", p ", ifelse(p_value_USA_TW==0, "< 0.001", paste("=",p_value_USA_TW)), "\nAccessory both: r =", cor_coefficient_Accessory_USA_TW, ", p ", ifelse(p_value_Accessory_USA_TW==0, "< 0.001", paste("=",p_value_Accessory_USA_TW))), size = 4, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#364B9A", "#4A7BB7","#98CAE1", "#A50026", "#F67E4B", "#FEDA8B"))+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Infant Invasive Disease (n=", (length(TW_samples)+length(CDC_metadata)), ")"))

p_USA_TW
```

## 1.3. NL vs TW
```{r}
# Reformat gene presence/absence data

         Total_TW = rowSums(across(all_of(TW_samples))),

  filter(Total_NL +Total_TW !=0)

shade_data <- data.frame(x = seq(0, 1, by = 0.01))
shade_data <- shade_data %>%
  mutate(ymin_5 = pmax(0, x - 0.05),
         ymax_5 = pmin(1, x + 0.05),
         ymin_10 = pmax(0, x - 0.10),
         ymax_10 = pmin(1, x + 0.10),
         ymin_15 = pmax(0, x - 0.15),
         ymax_15 = pmin(1, x + 0.15),
         ymin_25 = pmax(0, x - 0.25),
         ymax_25 = pmin(1, x + 0.25))

# Prepare data

  mutate(Type = ifelse(Proportion_NL >= 0.95, 
                       ifelse(Proportion_TW >= 0.95, "Core both", "Core NL"), 
                       ifelse(Proportion_TW >= 0.95, "Core TW", 
                              ifelse((Proportion_NL >= 0.05 & Proportion_TW >= 0.05), "Accessory both", 
                                     ifelse((Proportion_NL >= 0.05 & Proportion_TW < 0.05), "Accessory NL", "Accessory TW")))))

# Correlation test

cor_coefficient_Accessory_TW_NL  <- round(cor_test_Accessory_TW_NL$estimate, 2)

  geom_ribbon(data = shade_data, aes(x = x, ymin = ymin_25, ymax = ymax_25), fill = "grey95", alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_point(data= gene_pres_abs_clean_TW_NL_V3, aes(x = Proportion_NL, y = Proportion_TW, color = Type)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.05, 0.95), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.05, 0.95), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "black") +

  ylab(paste0("Gene frequencies in TW (n=", length(TW_samples), ")")) +
```

# 2. Plot gene frequencies Across Countries - EOD only 
```{r}
# Subset EOD samples 
NL_samples_EOD <- NL_samples[NL_samples %in% (metadata |> filter(Age_cat =="EOD") |> pull(Sample))]
CDC_samples_EOD <- CDC_samples[CDC_samples %in% (metadata |> filter(Age_cat =="EOD") |> pull(Sample))]
TW_samples_EOD <- TW_samples[TW_samples %in% (metadata |> filter(Age_cat =="EOD") |> pull(Sample))]
```

## 2.1. NL vs USA
```{r}
# Reformat gene presence/absence data
gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_EOD <- gene_pres_abs |>  
  dplyr::select(contains(c("Gene", NL_samples_EOD, CDC_samples_EOD))) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(c(NL_samples_EOD, CDC_samples_EOD)), ~ ifelse(. == "", 0, 1)))

# Calculate the Total and proportion of samples carrying a given gene in each population
gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_EOD_V2 <- gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_EOD |> 
  mutate(Total_NL = rowSums(across(all_of(NL_samples_EOD))), 
         Total_CDC = rowSums(across(all_of(CDC_samples_EOD))), 
         Proportion_NL = Total_NL/length(NL_samples_EOD), 
         Proportion_CDC = Total_CDC/length(CDC_samples_EOD)) |> 
  filter(Total_NL +Total_CDC !=0)

# All genes
# Create a data frame for shading the region (independent of gene_pres_abs_clean_V2)
shade_data <- data.frame(x = seq(0, 1, by = 0.01))
shade_data <- shade_data %>%
  mutate(ymin_5 = pmax(0, x - 0.05),
         ymax_5 = pmin(1, x + 0.05),
         ymin_10 = pmax(0, x - 0.10),
         ymax_10 = pmin(1, x + 0.10),
         ymin_15 = pmax(0, x - 0.15),
         ymax_15 = pmin(1, x + 0.15),
         ymin_25 = pmax(0, x - 0.25),
         ymax_25 = pmin(1, x + 0.25))

# Prepare data
gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_EOD_V3 <- gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_EOD_V2 |> 
  filter(!(Proportion_NL < 0.05 & Proportion_CDC < 0.05)) |> 
  mutate(Type = ifelse(Proportion_NL >= 0.95, 
                       ifelse(Proportion_CDC >= 0.95, "Core both", "Core NL"), 
                       ifelse(Proportion_CDC >= 0.95, "Core CDC", 
                              ifelse((Proportion_NL >= 0.05 & Proportion_CDC >= 0.05), "Accessory both", 
                                     ifelse((Proportion_NL >= 0.05 & Proportion_CDC < 0.05), "Accessory NL", "Accessory CDC")))))

# Correlation test 
## All genes
cor_test_USA_NL_EOD <- cor.test(gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_EOD_V3$Proportion_NL, gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_EOD_V3$Proportion_CDC)
cor_coefficient_USA_NL_EOD <- round(cor_test_USA_NL_EOD$estimate, 2)
p_value_USA_NL_EOD <- signif(cor_test_USA_NL_EOD$p.value, 3)
# Accessory in both genes
gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_EOD_V4 <- gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_EOD_V3 |>  filter(Type == "Accessory both")
cor_test_Accessory_USA_NL_EOD <- cor.test(gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_EOD_V4$Proportion_NL, gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_EOD_V4$Proportion_CDC)
cor_coefficient_Accessory_USA_NL_EOD  <- round(cor_test_Accessory_USA_NL_EOD$estimate, 2)
p_value_Accessory_USA_NL_EOD  <- signif(cor_test_Accessory_USA_NL_EOD$p.value, 3)


# plot 
p_USA_NL_EOD <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = shade_data, aes(x = x, ymin = ymin_5, ymax = ymax_5), fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_ribbon(data = shade_data, aes(x = x, ymin = ymin_25, ymax = ymax_25), fill = "grey95", alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_point(data= gene_pres_abs_clean_USA_NL_EOD_V3, aes(x = Proportion_NL, y = Proportion_CDC, color = Type)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.05, 0.95), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.05, 0.95), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "black") +  
  theme_classic() +
  xlab(paste0("Gene frequencies in Netherlands (n=", length(NL_samples_EOD), ")")) +
  ylab(paste0("Gene frequencies in USA (n=", length(CDC_samples_EOD), ")")) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 0.9, hjust = 0, label = paste("Pearson's correlation:\nAll: r =", cor_coefficient_USA_NL_EOD, ", p ", ifelse(p_value_USA_NL_EOD==0, "< 0.001", paste("=",p_value_USA_NL_EOD)), "\nAccessory both: r =", cor_coefficient_Accessory_USA_NL_EOD, ", p ", ifelse(p_value_Accessory_USA_NL_EOD==0, "< 0.001", paste("=",p_value_Accessory_USA_NL_EOD))), size = 4, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#364B9A", "#4A7BB7","#98CAE1", "#A50026", "#F67E4B", "#FEDA8B"))+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Infant Invasive Disease (n=", (length(NL_samples_EOD)+length(CDC_samples_EOD)), ")"))

p_USA_NL_EOD

# save
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pangenome_analysis/1.COG_freq_correlation_USA_NL_EOD.png", plot = p_USA_NL_EOD, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")
```

## 2.3. NL vs TW
```{r}
# Reformat gene presence/absence data
gene_pres_abs_clean_TW_NL_EOD <- gene_pres_abs |>  
  dplyr::select(contains(c("Gene", NL_samples_EOD, TW_samples_EOD))) |>

# Calculate the Total and proportion of samples carrying a given gene in each population
gene_pres_abs_clean_TW_NL_EOD_V2 <- gene_pres_abs_clean_TW_NL_EOD |> 
  mutate(Total_NL = rowSums(across(all_of(NL_samples_EOD))), 
         Total_TW = rowSums(across(all_of(TW_samples_EOD))), 
         Proportion_NL = Total_NL/length(NL_samples_EOD), 
         Proportion_TW = Total_TW/length(TW_samples_EOD)) |> 
  filter(Total_NL +Total_TW !=0)

# All genes
# Create a data frame for shading the region (independent of gene_pres_abs_clean_V2)
shade_data <- data.frame(x = seq(0, 1, by = 0.01))

  mutate(ymin_5 = pmax(0, x - 0.05),
         ymax_5 = pmin(1, x + 0.05),
         ymin_10 = pmax(0, x - 0.10),
         ymax_10 = pmin(1, x + 0.10),
         ymin_15 = pmax(0, x - 0.15),
```

```{r}
  annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 0.9, hjust = 0, label = paste("Pearson's correlation:\nAll: r =", cor_coefficient_TW_NL_LOD, ", p ", ifelse(p_value_TW_NL_LOD==0, "< 0.001", paste("=",p_value_TW_NL_LOD)), "\nAccessory both: r =", cor_coefficient_Accessory_TW_NL_LOD, ", p ", ifelse(p_value_Accessory_TW_NL_LOD==0, "< 0.001", paste("=",p_value_Accessory_TW_NL_LOD))), size = 4, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#364B9A", "#4A7BB7","#98CAE1", "#A50026", "#F67E4B", "#FEDA8B"))+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Infant Invasive Disease (n=", (length(NL_samples_LOD)+length(TW_samples_LOD)), ")"))

p_TW_NL_LOD

# save
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pangenome_analysis/1.COG_freq_correlation_TW_NL_LOD.png", plot = p_TW_NL_LOD, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")
```
